title: 第二十三章飞天望月之术第二十四章浴火重生
content_zh:
“哼，无论如何，这小子也不可能活着离开这里，至于你这头妖兽，也随老朽回望月宗看门去吧！”
“呀！！”毕长老摇动着手里的灵器，磅礴肆虐的音波之声，朝着苏阳和紫电狂狮同时涌去。
苏阳见状，一跃而起坐在了紫电狂狮背上道：“小弟，弄死这什么望月宗的长老！”
“得嘞~这老太婆自寻死路，我们就成全她。”紫电狂狮咆哮一声，身上散发出阵阵闪电。
闪烁的雷电之力，犹如长蛇一般朝着毕长老而去。
与此同时，紫电狂狮的身影一闪，以极快的速度消失在虚空之中。
毕长老见状，瞳孔一缩，倒也不惧。
只见其神威爆发，三玄之气顿时涌动。整个人的气势节节攀升，看着消失在虚空中的一人一兽，毕长老右脚一跺，顿时爆发出惊人的灵气，朝四周不断散去。
“速度倒是很快，不过，就凭这点小把戏，也想伤害到本长老不成？给我死来！！”毕长老朝虚空某处探出干枯的手掌，猛然一抓。
一道紫电身影立刻显露出来。
“老太婆，受死！”紫电狂狮也朝毕长老猛然一抓，如撕裂虚空般的强大力量呼啸而去。
与此同时，苏阳金光一闪，如残影一般消失在了紫电狂狮的背上。
毕长老见状，再度掏出铃铛，不断摇晃。
同时单掌拍出，宛如山岳般的巨大手掌，将紫电狂狮的攻势瞬间瓦解。
就在这时，消失的苏阳不知何时出现在了毕长老的头顶之上，手里的长棍蕴含着万斤之力，不留余地的砸了下去。
感受到头顶上空传来的毁灭力量时，毕长老神情一变，将铃铛朝头顶一丢，只见那铃铛瞬间变大，将毕长老的整个身躯都笼罩了进去。
当~
震耳欲聋的铃声顿时响彻整个黑夜。
散发出的灵气波动，将方圆十里的房屋都掀为废墟。
隐匿在附近的散修以及势力修士，由于境界过低，又太过靠近，不少人都被铃铛散发出的强大灵气，轰中了身躯，当场炸裂而亡。

就连李北叶也用尽了全身力量，才得以避免这股强大灵气的波及。
“这小子！居然还能有这么强的力量？那可是望月宗的长老，神武境圆满的强大高手啊。”语言上的惊叹似乎难以表达李北叶此刻心中情绪，他只想苏阳能够有机会活着，到时候无论如何也要让苏阳用体内的至尊之血，救她女儿一命！！！
哪怕是无比强大的紫电狂狮，由于就在苏阳身后，那一棍爆发出的力量，加上铃铛的强大音波。都让其不由被震飞百米，面部表情都极度扭曲了起来，要不是这些日子它在石头世界里修炼了几天肉体之术，怕是刚才的灵气波动，就得让其重伤。
“靠！老大还这么有力气？这等可怕的功法，简直能够媲美天级武学了。”紫电狂狮强行稳住身形后，不无震撼道。
要说最震撼的，自然是被铃铛保护住的毕长老。
身为神武圆满境的她，自然清楚自己手中铃铛的可怕之处，不仅能够杀人于无形，还有着强悍的防御力，乃是攻防一体的罕见灵器。也是望月宗宗主亲自奖赏给她的中级灵宝！
可刚才苏阳那一棍，让在铃铛里的毕长老，终于感受到了什么叫可怕的力量与战意。
content_en:
"Hmph, no matter what, there is no way this kid can leave here alive. As for you, a monster, just follow the old man back to Wangyue Sect to guard the door!"
"Ah!!" Elder Bi shook the spiritual weapon in his hand, and majestic and raging sound waves rushed towards Su Yang and the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion at the same time.
Seeing this, Su Yang jumped up and sat on the back of the purple lightning lion and said: "Little brother, kill this elder of Wangyue Sect!"
"Come on~ This old woman is looking for death, we will help her." The purple electric lion roared, and bursts of lightning emitted from its body.
The power of flashing thunder and lightning headed towards Elder Bi like a long snake.
At the same time, the figure of the purple lightning mad lion flashed and disappeared into the void at an extremely fast speed.
When Elder Bi saw this, his pupils shrank, but he was not afraid.
His divine power exploded, and the energy of the Three Mysteries suddenly surged. The momentum of the whole person was rising steadily. Looking at the man and the beast disappearing into the void, Elder Bi stamped his right foot, and an astonishing amount of spiritual energy suddenly burst out and continued to disperse in all directions.
"The speed is very fast, but with this little trick, can you still hurt me? Come and die!!" Elder Bi stretched out his dry palm somewhere in the void and grabbed it suddenly.
A purple electric figure immediately appeared.
"Old woman, suffer death!" The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion also suddenly grabbed Elder Bi, and roared away with a powerful force like tearing through the void.
At the same time, Su Yang's golden light flashed and disappeared like an afterimage on the back of the purple electric lion.
Seeing this, Elder Bi took out the bell again and kept shaking it.
At the same time, he shot out a single palm, a huge palm like a mountain, instantly disintegrating the purple electric lion's offensive.
At this moment, Su Yang, who had disappeared, appeared above Elder Bi's head. The long stick in his hand contained ten thousand catties of power, and he smashed it down without leaving any room.
When he felt the destructive power coming from the sky above his head, Elder Bi's expression changed and he threw the bell over his head. The bell instantly grew larger and enveloped Elder Bi's entire body.
When~
The deafening ringing suddenly rang throughout the night.
The fluctuations of spiritual energy emitted turned the houses within a ten-mile radius into ruins.
Among the casual cultivators and powerful cultivators hiding nearby, due to their low level and being too close, many of them were hit by the powerful spiritual energy emitted by the bell, and exploded to death on the spot.
Even Li Beiye used all his strength to avoid being affected by this powerful spiritual energy.
"This kid! How can he still be so powerful? That's the elder of Wangyue Sect, a powerful master who has perfected the Divine Martial Realm." The exclamation in words seems to be difficult to express the emotion in Li Beiye's heart at this moment. He just wants Su Yang to have a chance to live, and no matter what, he must let Su Yang use the supreme blood in his body to save his daughter's life! ! !
Even if it is the extremely powerful Purple Lightning Lion, because it is right behind Su Yang, the power burst out from that stick plus the powerful sound wave of the bell. It was involuntarily knocked a hundred meters away, and its facial expression became extremely distorted. If it hadn't been practicing physical skills in the stone world for several days these days, it would have been seriously injured due to the fluctuation of spiritual energy just now.
"Damn! Boss is still so strong? Such terrifying skills are comparable to heaven-level martial arts." The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion said in shock after forcibly stabilizing his body.
The most shocking thing was of course Elder Bi who was protected by the bell.
As a person who has reached the perfection level of Shenwu, she is naturally aware of the terrifying aspects of the bell in her hand. It can not only kill people invisible, but also has strong defensive power. It is a rare spiritual weapon that combines offense and defense. It was also an intermediate spiritual treasure that was personally awarded to her by the leader of the Wangyue Sect!
But with Su Yang's stick just now, Elder Bi, who was in the bell, finally felt what terrible power and fighting spirit was.
